Dear KeHE Deductions,

This is to inform you that we dispute claim R-0000496, which was taken on March 1, 2015, for $37.08. The dispute deadline was August 28, 2015, and it has passed. Please review this matter promptly.

Thank you for your attention.

Sincerely,
Northfield Pantry Co.
